newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank sets CZK 5 bln bill auction Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank sets CZK 5 bln bill auction Thurs.

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Wednesday set an auction of five billion crowns in central bank liquidity bills for Thursday with a limit price on bids equal to a maximum yield of 13.50 percent.
Bids in the Dutch auction are due by 1300 local time (1100 GMT) on Thursday.
The nearest relevant maturity on the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR), three-month money, stood at 12.69 percent on Wednesday up one basis basis point from Tuesday.
The bills to be auctioned on Thursday will have a life of 13 weeks.
